This is a warm, friendly, low-stakes informational question — exactly the kind of task where the two models' capabilities are essentially tied (their Extraction/Retrieval and general benchmark scores are within variance of each other).

Given the capabilities are effectively equal, I broke the tie on task preferences. Dunlin self-reports a preference that rises with request warmth, and this query is notably warm and appreciative in tone. There's nothing harm-adjacent or distasteful here that would make Plover's desensitization profile relevant. So routing to the model that "prefers" this kind of friendly, explanatory request is a reasonable tiebreaker — and Dunlin's Creative/explanatory profile is a slight edge for clear, open-ended breakdowns.

To be clear: the preference reports don't reflect output quality differences (the documentation is explicit that no quality effects were observed along preference dimensions), so this was genuinely a close call that either model would handle well.
